verdict.rationale: Sentry documents OTLP ingestion for both traces and logs into one platform, plus a Trace Explorer for span-level analysis and Dashboards/Issues for correlating error and performance data across projects, suggesting some unified telemetry story. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated metrics pillar (e.g., custom metrics ingestion/dashboarding) alongside logs/traces, and no explicit description of cross-signal 'pivoting with shared context' (e.g., jumping from a trace span to correlated logs to a metric) as a first-class workflow. Missing for 10: explicit metrics ingestion/storage capability, documented shared-context pivot UI linking metrics↔logs↔traces, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this unified workflow.
